title: Apps should autostart only after Plasma has finished launching
line: Autostart apps now open only once the wallpaper and panels have finished loading, instead of on a black screen during login.
explanation: With the systemd boot, autostart apps are ordered only after graphical-session.target, which was reached as soon as plasmashell had claimed its D-Bus name, before it had loaded the desktop and panels; the classic boot started them right after the autostart phases too. So apps appeared on a black screen or the splash before Plasma was there. A new oneshot unit, plasma-wait-for-shell.service, runs the existing plasma_waitforname --unregistered org.kde.PlasmaLoading (the same signal ksplash waits for) before graphical-session.target, and plasma_session runs the same wait before restoring the session and starting phase 2 apps. plasma_waitforname's 60 s timeout keeps autostart working if the shell never finishes loading.

commits.message:
startkde: start autostart apps after the desktop has finished loading

Autostart apps were started as soon as plasmashell was launched, so they
could show up on a black screen before the wallpaper and panels. Now the
session waits until Plasma reports it has finished loading, like ksplash.

BUG: 473860

patches.diff:
From f8d0bc98c9c3c8e07b89a06d91ef0a035181cf6a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:50:46 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] startkde: start autostart apps after the desktop has finished
 loading

Autostart apps were started as soon as plasmashell was launched, so they
could show up on a black screen before the wallpaper and panels. Now the
session waits until Plasma reports it has finished loading, like ksplash.

BUG: 473860
---
 startkde/plasma-session/startup.cpp               | 2 ++
 startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt                   | 1 +
 startkde/systemd/plasma-wait-for-shell.service.in | 9 +++++++++
 startkde/systemd/plasma-workspace.target          | 1 +
 4 files changed, 13 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 startkde/systemd/plasma-wait-for-shell.service.in

diff --git a/startkde/plasma-session/startup.cpp b/startkde/plasma-session/startup.cpp
index 73eacc95e6..8705606328 100644
--- a/startkde/plasma-session/startup.cpp
+++ b/startkde/plasma-session/startup.cpp
@@ -161,6 +161,8 @@ Startup::Startup(QObject *parent)
         new StartServiceJob(QStringLiteral("ksmserver"), QCoreApplication::instance()->arguments().mid(1), QStringLiteral("org.kde.ksmserver")),
         new StartupPhase0(autostart, this),
         phase1 = new StartupPhase1(autostart, this),
+        new StartProcessJob(QStringLiteral(CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_BINDIR "/plasma_waitforname"),
+                            {QStringLiteral("--unregistered"), QStringLiteral("org.kde.PlasmaLoading")}),
         new RestoreSessionJob(),
         new StartupPhase2(autostart, this),
     };
diff --git a/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt b/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt
index 64e06e9f6b..42e4c230a9 100644
--- a/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/startkde/systemd/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 install(FILES plasma-core.target DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
 install(FILES plasma-workspace.target DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
 install(FILES plasma-workspace-wayland.target DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
+ecm_install_configured_files(INPUT plasma-wait-for-shell.service.in @ONLY DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_SYSTEMDUSERUNITDIR})
 
 add_executable(kde-systemd-start-condition kde-systemd-start-condition.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(kde-systemd-start-condition PUBLIC KF6::ConfigCore KF6::Service PlasmaAutostart)
diff --git a/startkde/systemd/plasma-wait-for-shell.service.in b/startkde/systemd/plasma-wait-for-shell.service.in
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..2f2d401255
--- /dev/null
+++ b/startkde/systemd/plasma-wait-for-shell.service.in
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+[Unit]
+Description=Wait for the Plasma desktop to finish loading
+After=plasma-plasmashell.service
+Before=graphical-session.target
+
+[Service]
+Type=oneshot
+ExecStart=@CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_BINDIR@/plasma_waitforname --unregistered org.kde.PlasmaLoading
+Slice=session.slice
diff --git a/startkde/systemd/plasma-workspace.target b/startkde/systemd/plasma-workspace.target
index ff89b452b8..c7521f12c1 100644
--- a/startkde/systemd/plasma-workspace.target
+++ b/startkde/systemd/plasma-workspace.target
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@ Wants=kio-fuse.service
 Wants=plasma-foreground-booster.service
 Wants=plasma-kwallet-pam.service
 Wants=plasma-startupsound.service
+Wants=plasma-wait-for-shell.service
 Wants=xdg-desktop-autostart.target
 BindsTo=graphical-session.target
 Before=graphical-session.target
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: a test autostart app checks org.kde.PlasmaLoading when it starts: Plasma was still loading (it starts ~0.7 s before the splash ends).
With the fix: the same autostart app starts after Plasma reports it has finished loading ("still loading: false").

reviews.text: Delaying autostart apps until Plasma finishes loading is a valid goal, but inserting plasma-wait-for-shell.service with plasma_waitforname --unregistered org.kde.PlasmaLoading before graphical-session.target introduces a 60-second login hang race and poor failure behavior. As the regression test itself demonstrates, plasma_waitforname --unregistered times out after 60 seconds when org.kde.PlasmaLoading is absent, so any fast or headless startup where plasmashell drops the name before the oneshot connects—or any session where plasmashell fails or is disabled—will stall graphical-session.target for a full minute.
changes: Eliminate the race condition with plasma_waitforname --unregistered org.kde.PlasmaLoading (which hangs for 60 s if plasmashell drops the name before the service starts or never registers it), for example by signalling readiness directly from plasmashell (e.g. Type=notify / sd_notify or a non-racy readiness mechanism) instead of an external wait-for-unregistration helper started After=plasma-plasmashell.service.

Order the wait before xdg-desktop-autostart.target (and plasma-restoresession.service / plasma-startupsound.service if desired) rather than blocking all of graphical-session.target, so unrelated graphical user services (portals, input methods, daemons) are not delayed or deadlocked.

Ensure the unit does not stall login for 60 s when plasma-plasmashell.service fails or is disabled/masked (e.g. via Requisite=/BindsTo= or handling shell readiness directly) and add PartOf=graphical-session.target so it is torn down on early logout.
Runtime-test the classic boot (startup.cpp) path and ensure it cannot hang for 60 s if plasmashell starts slowly, finishes early, or is not launched.

reviews.text: The idea is right and reuses existing pieces: wait for plasmashell to drop org.kde.PlasmaLoading (the same signal ksplash uses) before graphical-session.target in the systemd boot, and before RestoreSessionJob/phase 2 in the classic boot. The probe evidence shows autostart now follows shell readiness with about 1.5 s of extra delay. Two gaps need fixing first. (1) startplasma registers org.kde.PlasmaLoading itself and only plasmashell replaces and releases it, so in any session where plasmashell doesn't run (masked unit, a custom shell or bar), graphical-session.target and every autostart app are now held for the full 60 s at each login; the unit is only After=plasma-plasmashell.service, with no Requisite. (2) Holding graphical-session.target is broader than autostart: units such as xdg-desktop-portal.service (After=graphical-session.target on this distro) can't be activated until it is reached, so any portal call made while the shell loads now waits up to the 60 s timeout; that case and the classic boot path (systemdBoot=false) were not tested.
changes: Skip the wait when plasmashell isn't part of the session (e.g. Requisite=/BindsTo=plasma-plasmashell.service, or equivalent), so setups without plasmashell don't get a 60 s delay at every login.
Make the timeout non-fatal (ExecStart=-…) so a slow shell doesn't leave a failed unit, and consider a shorter --timeout than 60 s for the worst case.

Test the classic boot path (plasma_session StartProcessJob) and check that nothing plasmashell D-Bus-activates during load is ordered After=graphical-session.target (xdg-desktop-portal.service is), or explain in the MR why this is safe.
